crossRefs.note: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;
Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption…
He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
“A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.
Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
translations.bsb: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
translations.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
translations.asv: But we hoped that it was he who should redeem Israel. Yea and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things came to pass.
